findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-201.11 Floors, Walls, and Ceilings. Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

1) Both bathrooms have ceiling tiles of the acoustic type. These are not smooth and easily cleanable and need to either be replaced with smooth and easily cleanable tiles or made smooth and easily cleanable via paint or a sealant. Do this prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure smooth and easily cleanable surfaces in the facilities where moisture can accumulate. 2) The hand sink in the left bathroom is pulling away from the wall and exposing a gap. Previous inspections had this as having a work order in approximately two years ago. This situation needs to be remedied prior to the next routine inspection.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The violation from last routine inspection is present. The hand sink for the restroom on the left is completely detached from the wall and not functioning. A ticket has been put in for the sink to be repaired. The restroom is marked out of order. 

5-203.11: (A) Specified under LAW, facility must have a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEESS. (B) If APPROVED, automatic handwashing may be substituted. (C) IF APPROVED, chemically treated towelettes can be used.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed single use articles in a box on the floor for merchandising. The box was moved up off of the floor. The violation is considered corrected on site.  Remember to keep food and clean items off of the floor.

4-903.11: (A) clean EQUIPMENT and clean ARTICLES shall be stored in clean, dry location where they are not exposed to contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. (C) SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be kept in original PACKAGE or stored in manner to protect it against contamination.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent. 

Observed exterior door to be no longer tightly sealed. Repair before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-501.112: Dead or trapped birds, insects, rodents, and other pests shall be removed from control devices and the PREMISES at a frequency that prevents their accumulation, decomposition, or the attraction of pests. 

Observed dead insects in back room. Ensure routine cleaning occurs. Repeat from 10/8/19.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED. 

Observed lack of caulk in the bathroom to the left. Re-caulk before next routine inspection.
